authority_and_single_coordinator: Submit atomically creates exactly one existing canonical Task, original request idempotency and TASK_QUEUED event in original DB; no Run or launch before Coordinator.Scan/commit.

Same Coordinator observing the same DB is the actual status/event authority. No shadow task store, second scheduler, renderer cache or adapter-only terminal state may impersonate persisted Run/lease/outbox facts.

Original principal+project+operation+request_id same canonical payload returns original response/task. Changed payload ->409; lost ACK exact lookup recovers original Task with no second Run/launch. NOT_FOUND read does not authorize new ID/relaunch.

Current Host/principal/project/workspace permission is checked independently for submit/read/history/events/cancel and again before launch. Revoke project grant/workspace or change binding after queued ACK -> no fake launch. Capabilities can_submit alone is not authority.

API body cannot set executable,argv,providerendpoint,token,owner/trusted boolean. Duplicate/unknown/trailing fields and unsupported capabilities fail closed; auth/private scheduler credentials are never returned or passed to fake child.
execution_and_unknown: Fake harness is invoked through existing admission/dispatch/lease/Coordinator with actual Task+Run+epoch. Terminal protocol with complete owned cleanup only ->COMPLETED; stderr/exit0 or queued ACK alone are not terminal proof.
Malformed/missing/duplicate protocol terminal, wrong thread/run identity, output bound, lost stream or ambiguous launch -> exact FAILED/UNKNOWN/block semantics without auto requeue or new request_id.

Restart/recovery uses trusted persisted original dispatch facts; never retries an uncertain external launch merely because live adapter handle is missing. Retain all failure and UNKNOWN records/counters.

Structured messages/tool events are observed whole native events, not fabricated token deltas, tool success, Gitdiff,usage/cost or model qualification. Host-redacted logs and private IDs remain bounded.
cancel_and_cleanup: Queued cancel CAS checks exact Task revision and both Run/epoch null. Claim race ->409, cannot cancel newly observed active Run.
Active cancel checks exact revision,actual run_id,canonical decimal epoch. Old/foreign/mixed/null pair rejected without canceling another owned job.

Durable CANCEL_REQUESTED is not CANCELLED. Fake owned Job and stream/drain completion must settle before terminal event+Task state atomically commit; cleanup failure or unknown process state cannot become cancel success.
Cancellation duplicate same request_id/body returns original response; changed target/body ->conflict. Already terminal matching target does not launch/replay/grant anything.
Helper tests may use approved actual fakeJob fixtures, but never real Codex/model/old DB/GUI or unrelated processes. Exact fixture process classification must be recorded after reading frozen tests.
history_cursor_and_wire: Epoch/revision/sequence/cursors use strict canonical decimal strings through int64max. Reject negative,leadingzero,float,scientific,overflow,numericJSON and partial run/epoch pairs.
Task list cursor and event cursor have separate semantics; request_id lookup ignores pagination. All rows remain authorized principal/project/task scope.

Future/unavailable event cursor ->reset=true,empty events,authoritative snapshot/tail,end terminal only; normal pages snapshot=null and cursor never regresses. Run/epoch change keeps event cursor history.
Terminal Task with remaining event pages has end=false. Final exhausted page has end=true. No event/result from another thread/task/project or old Run incorrectly projected as current.

Rev2 capability payload uses PLATFORM_POLICY hooks/MCP, independent installation/login/verification, and false write/resume/pause/pertoolapproval/diff/files/attachments/token_delta. No fixture metadata may promote LIVE_OBSERVED/enforcement_verified.
legacy_and_scope: Existing Mu/V2 route still uses original provider/config/admission/dispatch/recovery. Only exact harness task_type branch uses new driver; nil/default path not globally reinterpreted.

No old DB migration/adoption or paused Core/Native worktree activation. Eighteen exactpaths only, source manifests byte-pinned, retained old failures and author fixture issues distinct from implementation failures.

Fixed Codex argv configuration is judged against D03 intent/platform boundary, not superseded all-hooks-disabled claims. Never dangerous bypass, user-config/auth copy, CODEX_HOME rewrite or --sandbox mixed with default_permissions.

post_freeze_execution.first: Check actual manifest/summary/freeze filenames, bytes/hashes and exact18 scope; retain frozen copy and author failures before candidate analysis.
post_freeze_execution.tests: Locked offline Go, own new C cache/temp/profile, fresh SQLite, Recorder and fake harness/owned fakeJob only; meaningful independent overlay stored in C and no candidate edits.
post_freeze_execution.vet: Independent necessary vet after valid fixture tests, recorded as real terminal result rather than source author result.
post_freeze_execution.evidence: Preserve command argv/env, input hashes, raw stdout/stderr, actual run/pass/fail roster, terminal exit and post-check no-drift pins. Fixture errors get their own stable origin/classification, never hide or reset original failures.
post_freeze_execution.decision: Only after actual checks may review.json use APPROVED_SOURCE_FIXTURE_ONLY/formal_increment0/pending_blockers[]; actual defects require changes and new freeze. No real product/runtime acceptance.

diagnostic_events.detail: Whole rev2 schema rendering exceeded output budget. Parse the owned copied interface structurally for targeted DTO review rather than infer omitted fields.
